What if China won the AI war, and the West didn’t realize it until it was already over?

In this day-by-day scenario, a mysterious Chinese AI system is deployed across finance, cyberwarfare, robotics, intelligence, and military operations. Within days, markets are disrupted, Taiwan is attacked by autonomous machines, Western intelligence networks are exposed, and critical infrastructure becomes leverage. But the biggest victory isn’t won on a battlefield. Control of Taiwan puts advanced chip production under Beijing’s influence, while AI breakthroughs give China new diplomatic power across the world.

No nuclear war. No invasion of America. Just a rapid shift in who controls the systems the modern world depends on.
